name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_begin_connect
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::BeginConnect reads the status-server edit text into the WOL connect context, asks the WOL provider to prepare the context and mode, appends the matching localized status message, and starts the prepared connect request.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43e4b0 validates CWnd::GetWindowTextA on m_statusServerEdit with max count 9 into WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConnectContext::m_requestText, WOL provider PrepareConnectContextAndMode through vtable offset 0x70, mode/message selection 0/0x303b or 1/0x303c, AppendStatusTextFmt of the localized message, and BeginConnectWithPreparedContext through vtable offset 0x6c.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_begin_connect_smoke patches CWnd::GetWindowTextA, zLoc::GetMessageString, and AppendStatusTextFmt, and verifies both prepare-result branches, context pointer continuity, request text, mode, message id, and append target.
